page.notes: Uncertain: the three vertical bars "|" before "Quidam", "Sed" and after "veniunt" may be printer's marks rather than punctuation; copied as printed. The paragraph divisions before "2." and "3." are read from the numbers set mid-line; the printed layout may differ. Italic words were identified by their letter shapes; the italic setting of "Christum" in the first occurrence and of "Esai." is a visual judgement. Spelling of long s has been normalised to s throughout, as required. The line ending "domi-" continues on the next page as "nus", given as the catchword.
